Every clause of B.6 is stated somewhere, for the same general objects, except one: 'finite bounds on a smaller neighborhood'. all_radial_jets (ActivationHolomorphic.lean:1042) concludes Regular, which carries no bound, and no declaration was found that supplies one. Recovering the paper's clause needs boundedness of a continuous function on a compact subtube — true, one line, and not stated — so by the logic-alone rule the Lean states strictly less: partial, DELTA. Everything else is packaging. In particular V_0/X is stated, as the fifth base coefficient, so B's reformulation finding is withdrawn; and exists_initialTube asserts only nonemptiness, so it cannot be the declaration that states the corollary.

findings.summary: The clause 'finite bounds on a smaller neighborhood' for each fixed radial derivative is stated by no declaration found. all_radial_jets concludes only Regular, an open-set predicate with no sup-norm anywhere in its unfolding.
No declaration was found that bundles the corollary, or that binds t_c existentially with both t_c < t_1 and 4e^{t_c} < 4.1. The widths T, κ, δ stay ambient parameters of the regularity theorems.

Clause (iv), that all subsequent modifications live strictly right of X_0 e^{t_c}, is stated only stage by stage: the transition ramp and the modulation each separately leave the collar alone. No declaration found quantifies over all later stages.
